description: This file declares utility functions for parsing and extracting information from DER-encoded X.509 certificates, including extracting subjects, public keys, extensions, and signature algorithms.

methods.name: ExtractSubjectFromDERCert
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded certificate to extract the X.501 Subject bytes.

methods.name: ExtractSPKIFromDERCert
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded certificate to extract the SubjectPublicKeyInfo bytes.

methods.name: ExtractSubjectPublicKeyFromSPKI
methods.description: Parses DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo to extract the public key bytes.

methods.name: HasCanSignHttpExchangesDraftExtension
methods.description: Checks if the DER-encoded certificate contains the canSignHttpExchangesDraft extension.

methods.name: ExtractSignatureAlgorithmsFromDERCert
methods.description: Extracts the signature algorithm sequences from a DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: ExtractExtensionFromDERCert
methods.description: Extracts a specific extension from a DER-encoded X.509 certificate.
